id.description: Unique identifier for the data store instance.

dataId.description: Identifier for the specific action in {@link UiApDataStore#actionMap} to configure

args.description: Arguments to be used for data retrieval (typically query parameters, filters, etc.)

overwrite.description:
Whether to completely overwrite existing arguments (true) or merge with existing ones (false).
When false, new args are merged with existing args using object spread.

title:
Specification for setting arguments in a UI Asset Performance Data Store.

This type is used to configure arguments for data retrieval actions in the data store.
It allows components to specify how data should be fetched and whether existing
arguments should be overwritten or merged.
name: UiApDataStoreSetArgsSpec
